messages:
rachel: kicking off a config-only change now. goal: tighten small-request latency and reduce noisy cross-tenant interference. canary 4% for 8m.

rachel: diffs: routing.backoff_ms=30 (lower), tenant_share_floor=0.06, timeouts.idle_ms=130, batching.min_batch_tokens=64, batching.max_latency_ms=12

rachel: no model swap, only config flags. pin model to v2.3.1 as a safeguard.

deploy-bot: deploy queued 6483307777 by rachel. window 2026-03-22T05:09Z->2026-03-22T05:29Z. plan: 4% (8m) -> 25% (7m) -> 60% (5m) -> full.

tom: ack. i'll watch p50/p95 and per-AZ p99.

priya: add kvcache_hit_ratio and token/sec. last time backoff changes impacted cache locality.

infra-bot: automated check passed: config schema ok, no forbidden flags.

rachel: tenant override for canary cohort (sprint-dev-group):

```
overrides:
  routing:
    backoff_ms: 30
  tenant_throttle:
    tenant_share_floor: 0.06
  timeouts:
    idle_ms: 130
  batching:
    min_batch_tokens: 64
    max_latency_ms: 12
```

maya: applying overrides to cohort now. patch id 6483307789.

deploy-bot: canary started at 6483307795 targeting sprint-dev-group (4%). expected promote 6483308275.

tom: initial numbers look good. p95 +9ms, p99 flat.

priya: kvcache_hit_ratio 0.92 on canary, token/sec ~ 10.5k. good.

(6m later)

priya: small blip in kvcache on az-eu-west-1a: drop to 0.84 for ~90s then recovered. no CPU spike.
tom: p99 in that AZ +60ms during blip. looks like a cache eviction transient.

rachel: pause promote. deploy-bot pause requested. holding at 4%.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by rachel at 6483308199. reason: transient kvcache drop in eu-west-1a.

maya: adding an AZ-specific override to keep idle_ms at 150 in eu-west-1a while leaving main override. will push small change.
rachel: do it. also add temporary max_inflight_per_tenant=25 for that AZ.

maya: patch 6483308210 applied for AZ override.

infra-bot: monitoring rules updated. alert kvcache_hit_ratio < 0.85 for >1m -> notify channel + pause.

priya: metrics recovering. kvcache back to 0.9, p99 dropping.
tom: agree—stabilized. recommend slower ramp.
rachel: resume with slower ramp: 4% -> 15% (10m) -> 40% (10m) -> full.

deploy-bot: resume accepted. new plan set, starting at 6483308350.

(10m later)

tom: 15% stage stable across AZs. p95 within baseline.

rachel: advance to 40%, wait 10m.

(10m later)

priya: quality checks ok on smoke prompts. no regression in hallucination tests.

infra-bot: infra healthy, CPU <70%, kvcache steady.

rachel: rolling to full now. updating release notes: config-only change to backoff/tenant floors/batching to reduce noisy tails for small requests. diff id 6483309001.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 6483311400. status=SUCCESS. all cohorts updated.

rachel: thanks all. leaving this thread open for 24h for sticky issues, will file a short post if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
